nodes.label: The Impact of the Feed Rate and the Binder Concentration on the Morphology of Spray-Dried Alumina–Polymer Nanocomposites
nodes.description: The paper studies spray-drying of nano-alumina with PVP-30 to form alumina–polymer granules and quantifies how feed rate and binder concentration influence granule size, morphology, and porosity. Droplet size/velocity (HiWatch), inline granule imaging (SOPAT), SEM, and mercury intrusion porosimetry are combined to link atomization and process settings to product structure. Higher feed rate increases droplet size/velocity and yields larger, more porous granules, while higher binder concentration makes granules more compact and reduces nano-pore volume, providing a basis for process optimization and model-based control.
